autonomy.contract: No owner fact-confirmation at any stage. Every claim is verified autonomously per AUTONOMY.md: product claims -> source_local files + live site; competitor claims -> live competitor pages with archived evidence snapshots; regulatory facts -> official sources only; first-hand experience claims -> local evidence files (site repo, published posts, gallery/portfolio data); original-data claims -> computed arithmetic with archived inputs. INCONCLUSIVE always downgrades to a labeled placeholder or drops the sentence — it never blocks the pipeline and never escalates to a human question.
autonomy.tooling: scripts/verify_facts.py --config site-config.<project>.json writes claim-verification.<project>.json (dated ledger + evidence snapshots in evidence/<project>/)
autonomy.gates: check_article.py hard-fails on ledger status 'unsupported'; 'inconclusive'/'stale' are draft-time placeholder triggers; check_publish.py flags any live page asserting an unsupported claim
never_auto_assert: invented statistics, testimonials, or press mentions
claims whose only source is the draft itself
venue/experience claims with zero local evidence hits
